You'll be inside client environments every day, working in Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace tenants, on Windows and macOS endpoints, and across the long tail of SaaS each client runs their business on. You'll be the person a client messages when their team can't reach email on a Monday morning, and the person who makes sure it doesn't happen again. If you're a systems thinker who enjoys technical troubleshooting, you'll fit right in. What You'll Do You will be the backbone of our clients' technical operations. Access and permissions, email and deliverability, SaaS integrations, endpoints, user onboarding and offboarding. Infrastructure & SaaS: Administer client tenants across Google Workspace and Microsoft 365, covering identity, groups, licensing, mail routing, shared drives, and security policy. Security First: Implement and monitor endpoint security, including MFA, patch management, and access review. You'll be our clients' first line of defense in incident response. Systems Architecture: Assist with cloud infrastructure management, data backups, and disaster recovery planning across client environments. Automation & Integrations: Connect the systems our clients run, using tools like Zapier, n8n, MCPs, and native APIs. You'll get protected time each week to turn repeat tickets into automations that stop them coming back. AI in the Workflow: We lean on AI hard. It's how a small team supports a large client base. Cloud Fluency: Hands-on experience administering Google Workspace and Microsoft 365. review_candidates.description: The application window will be open until at least October 14, 2026. This opportunity will remain online based on business needs which may be before or after the specified date. Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: Thornton, CO, USA; Atlanta, GA, USA . Minimum qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 6 years of experience with IP networking, routing protocols, and network connectivity. Experience in network operations, troubleshooting, and infrastructure. Experience with Python and coding for automation. Experience with cloud networking, fiber optics, and transport networks. Preferred qualifications: Experience troubleshooting hardware and software on large-scale IP/MPLS networks. Experience with one or more scripting languages (e.g., Python). Experience analyzing business processes and creating data-driven recommendations for improvement. Experience with network routing and switching at scale, as well as IP network infrastructures and protocols. Experience with Software-Defined Networking (SDN), including control plane, data plane, and management plane. About The Job The Global Network Operations team runs the most reliable network, proactively monitoring and fixing issues, ensuring our users and customers are connected, our products are the most available and that we meet Google's demanding growth. As a Network Engineer in the Google Global Networking (GGN) team, you will work with other network engineers and technology teams in Google to identify and mitigate risks and ensure the smooth operation of core networking systems and platforms on the Google production network. The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide. We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more. Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $150000 - $217000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits Responsibilities Learn more about benefits at Google . Create workflow, network monitoring, and troubleshooting automation to improve the network. Debug complex issues and determine root causes for incidents impacting the network and customers. Develop, debug, and mitigate risk profiles to maintain optimal network health. Lead improvements in documentation, playbooks, and training for support organizations. Work with network design, deployment, and engineering teams to operationalize stable, scalable platforms. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .
